notes.title: 🌲 Release Date Announcement🌲
notes.notes:
🌲 BIG ANNOUCEMENT - TWO FALLS RELEASE NOVEMBER 8th 🌲

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514951/64a601932e6cec99f277dff28154cf52cef2b7f0.png

Hello, everyone!

The moment we've all been waiting for is finally here! We are thrilled to announce that Two Falls (Nishu Takuatshina) will officially launch on November 8th, 2024. It's been a long and exciting journey, and we can't wait for you to experience the world we've built, where two unique stories come together in a powerful narrative.

Whether you're drawn to the deep narrative, the dynamic environments, or the cultural significance of the game, Two Falls is an experience we believe will stay with you long after the credits roll.

If you haven't done so yet, don't forget to wishlist the game to get notified as soon as it's available! Every wishlist helps us reach more players who are passionate about narrative-driven games like this one. You can also follow us on Twitter (X) to join the conversation and share your thoughts with us. We’re always happy to hear from you and answer any questions!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514951/a5b0799c8902fb18b54f822d9ca57e402650fc41.png

Thank you all for your support and enthusiasm! We’re counting down the days until you can step into the world of Two Falls. See you on November 8th!

notes.title: Two Falls Reveals Release Period: Get ready for a Summer 2024 Adventure!
notes.notes:
Dear Two Falls Community,

We are thrilled to announce that Two Falls (Nishu Takuatshina) will be officially released in Summer 2024! 

The upcoming months promise to be exhilarating, featuring exclusive information drops and sneak peeks. We can't wait to share more details about the game's features, characters, and the captivating storyline awaiting you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41514951/d4a900b83083b326f5e39b0a79d8027e0062f3f1.png

Stay tuned for regular updates through our newsletter,  social media channels, and on our Steam page. Your support has been incredible, and we're eager to take you on this incredible journey with us.

Prepare for an epic Summer 2024 as Two Falls reveals its secrets. Thank you for being part of this incredible adventure!

Best regards,

The Unreliable Narrators Team
